title: Cadence strength workout, version 1
description: A strength workout as Cadence stores it on intervals.icu: planned, in a comment in the event's description; done, in the activity's CadenceStrength field. Weights are kilograms, times seconds, distances metres. Keys Cadence doesn't know are kept when it saves. Spec: https://wavio.co/cadence/strength-format/

cadence.description: Marks the JSON as Cadence's strength format.

v.description: The format's version. Cadence reads version 1 only.

exercises.description: The exercises in the order they are done.

bodyweight.description: Done sets only: the athlete's weight in kilograms that Weight lifted counted bodyweight sets with. Never in a plan.

exercise.description: Which exercise: its id in Cadence's library (https://wavio.co/cadence/exercises.json) and its name. An id Cadence doesn't know shows by its name.

measure.description: What a set records. Take it from the library's exercise.

per_side.description: Each side is counted on its own: 8 reps is 8 a side. Left out when false.

implements.description: 2 when two dumbbells, kettlebells or cable stacks are used at once; a set's kg is then one of them. Left out when 1.

rep_range.description: The reps are a range, reps to reps_max. Left out when false.

rest.description: Seconds of rest after each set. In a superset, after each round.

superset.description: A superset's letter, from A. Exercises next to each other with the same letter are done in turn, one set of each per round.

note.description: A note for the athlete, shown under the exercise.

set.description: One set. Which numbers it has follows the exercise's measure; a working set leaves type out.

type.description: A warm-up set. Left out for a working set.

reps_max.description: The top of a rep range; reps is the bottom.

kg.description: Always positive. The measure says whether it is lifted (weight_*), added to the body (weighted_reps) or taken off it (assisted_reps).
